final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks IREF=10uA
Mb0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=2
* tail current source 30uA
Mt  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=2 m=3
* NMOS input pair (vinp -> output side for non-inverting polarity)
M1  nd    vinn  tail vss nfet W=40 L=1
M2  n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=40 L=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3  nd    nd    vdd vdd pfet W=13 L=1
M4  n1    nd    vdd vdd pfet W=13 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (200uA)
M7  vout  n1    vdd vdd pfet W=110 L=0.6
M8  vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=2 m=20
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n1    nz    1.2k
Cc  nz    vout  1.5p
.ends
